items.summary: The IR release dated September 29 schedules the next earnings call for October 29. A calendar event, not a new earnings warning. Publication time of day is unavailable.
CXMT management described 4F² DRAM progress and a year-end server-memory product plan. Potential sector competition; this does not establish a direct hit to Sandisk NAND orders.
Nanya management described continued DRAM shortages and potential Q4 price and margin gains. Counterevidence to an immediate industry demand-collapse narrative.
Earlier sector review described falling memory shares alongside disagreement over supply expansion. This followed the October 8 session; it was not a forecast of that decline.
Micron-focused report discussed bearish options activity alongside bullish analyst views. Complex option trades do not establish net directional conviction in Sandisk.
Headline-only follow-up of the earlier CXMT event was published at 09:17 ET. It is another report of the same development, not an independent new catalyst.
An 11:44 ET report linked an already-observed memory-stock selloff to competition worries. This is post-move attribution, not advance proof of the decline.

community.method: Chinese phrase lexicon v1 uses six bullish and six bearish phrases. Instrument-name cashtags are removed before matching. Negation within four preceding characters suppresses a cue; title and excerpt are concatenated only when distinct. Balance is 100 * (bullish - bearish) / (bullish + bearish), a descriptive scale from -100 to +100, not confidence or a price-move probability. Mixed and unknown posts are excluded from this balance.
limitations: Counts describe all observed unique post versions, not posts available for trading at the cutoff or unique users.
Chinese phrase cues are a transparent heuristic, not a trained sentiment model; subject, sarcasm, conditions and retrospective remarks are not resolved.
The fixed simplified-Chinese lexicon does not comprehensively cover traditional Chinese, Cantonese, questions, slang or option-position shorthand; unknown is not neutral.
Query association does not establish that a post is about this stock. Author and engagement coverage is not assumed.
Stance balance is 100 * (bullish - bearish) / (bullish + bearish), on a -100 to +100 scale; mixed and unknown remain visible and are excluded. It is not an up-move probability.
No mechanical contrarian trade or probability of a future price move is inferred.
30 observed post versions were received after the cutoff and cannot support a contemporaneous replay.

limitations: Retrospective research only. These descriptive observations are not forecasts, buy/sell instructions, calibrated probabilities or an evaluated trading strategy.
Intraday timestamps are five-minute bar END times; a bar is included only after that entire interval is complete. Missing bars are not filled.
Intraday returns use the preceding observed market session close. Premarket is shown separately; the gap and open-to-cutoff return use the regular-session opening bar.
Daily return_pct is a raw close-price return normalized to the first date shared by the returned available series, not a total return or portfolio return.

Five- and twenty-session returns use matching endpoints on the observed reference calendar. SMA and simple mean true range require complete input windows; no official exchange-calendar completeness claim is made.

Candidate levels use only prior completed daily bars and are not guarantees of support or resistance. known_at is the underlying price-period close, not system receipt. Reference computed from prior completed prices; reconstructed after the event. Actual receipt is recorded separately as price_received_at.

Session VWAP excludes premarket. Provider bar VWAP is volume-weighted when available for every positive-volume regular bar; otherwise all bars use the OHLC typical-price proxy (high + low + close) / 3.
News counts may cover more articles than the selected public summaries. Publication before the cutoff alone does not establish that the system had received the text.
Price data was received after the analysis cutoff (post_cutoff); this snapshot cannot establish contemporaneous system availability.
Session VWAP method in this snapshot: volume-weighted provider bar VWAP.
Daily normalization baseline in this snapshot: 2026-07-01 close, equal to 0% for each available series.
